name: Customer Combo Feedback
description: Fill customers back to back and the game celebrates the streak — rainbow conveyor glow, pop-up words, and a giant MEGA COOL.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to pour marbles onto the belt. Every time a customer is completely filled you have 2 seconds to fill the next one. Keep the chain going: the 3rd in a row shows Cool, the 6th shows Very Cool, and the 9th shows a huge rainbow MEGA COOL that comes back every 4 after that. The rainbow glow around the conveyor is your timer — it fades as your 2 seconds run out and flares back up on every fill.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Combo Rush
showcaseLevel.desc: Eight open boxes, small customer orders — chain them fast
